record.question: Which amendment added the word ‘Secular’ in the Preamble to the Constitution of India?
record.explanation: Answer B: 42nd Amendment. The 42nd Amendment inserted “socialist” and “secular” into the Preamble in 1976. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
